abstract: To explore prenatal risk factors that are common to testicular cancer and cryptorchidism, two parallel case-control studies were conducted in Denmark. Information about characteristics of the mother, the pregnancy, and the birth were obtained from the mothers of cases and controls, using a mailed self-administered questionnaire. A maternal age above 30 years was associated with odds ratios (OR) of 1.9 (95 percent confidence interval [CI] = 1.2-3.0) for cryptorchidism and 2.0 (CI = 1.2-3.6) for testicular seminoma; the latter effect was particularly high when the boy was the first child of the mother (OR = 4.1, CI = 1.1-14.6). Birthweights below 3,000 g or above 4,000 g were associated with increased risks of testicular cancer, with ORs up to 2.6 (CI = 1.1-5.9) for birthweight below 2,500 g. For cryptorchidism, there was a monotonous trend in the OR from 0.4 in birthweights above 4,500 g to 2.3 in birthweights below 2,500 g. The association between cryptorchidism and testicular cancer was not attenuated by adjustment for maternal age and birthweight, indicating that all three variables are independent risk factors for testicular cancer. With the exception of high maternal age, which consistently is associated more strongly with seminoma than with non-seminoma, it remains most likely that seminoma and non-seminoma have similar causes.
abstract_ja: 目的：精巣がんと停留精巣に共通する出生前の危険因子を検討するため、デンマークで2つの並行した症例対照研究を行った。方法：症例と対照の母親に郵送による自記式質問票を送付し、母親、妊娠、出生に関する情報を取得した。結果：母親の年齢が30歳を超えることは、停留精巣のオッズ比(OR)1.9(95%信頼区間[CI] 1.2-3.0)、精巣セミノーマのOR 2.0(CI 1.2-3.6)と関連していた。とくに男児が第一子の場合は、セミノーマのORが4.1(CI 1.1-14.6)と高かった。出生体重が3,000g未満または4,000g超の場合、精巣がんのリスクが上昇し、OR は最大2.6(CI 1.1-5.9)で、出生体重2,500g未満で最大であった。停留精巣については、出生体重4,500g超でのORが0.4であった一方、2,500g未満では2.3へと単調に増加する傾向が見られた。停留精巣と精巣がんの関連は、母親の年齢および出生体重で調整しても減弱しなかった。結論：これら3つの変数はいずれも精巣がんの独立した危険因子である。母親の高齢はセミノーマで非セミノーマよりも強く関連するが、セミノーマと非セミノーマは同様の原因を持つ可能性が高い。
